bio: I'm Emmanuel, a UI/UX designer and creative based in Jos, Nigeria. I design digital products, build websites, and create visual identities and graphics that help businesses communicate clearly.

My work brings together interface design, branding, and AI-assisted creative production. I use tools such as Figma, Canva, CorelDRAW, ChatGPT, and Claude to explore ideas and develop them into finished work.
about.note: Based in Jos. Working across digital and visual design.

items.title: Ineba Gogo MFB
items.description: I designed the website for Ineba Gogo Microfinance Bank (IGMFB) to communicate trust and make its banking services easy to explore. The design combines bold typography, a dark colour palette, and vibrant yellow accents to create a confident visual identity. Clear navigation highlights personal, business, and digital banking, while prominent calls to action encourage visitors to take the next step. The goal was to create a welcoming digital presence that reflects the bank’s focus on empowering individuals and small businesses.

items.title: Belema Fintech Website
items.description: I designed the Belema Fintech website to showcase its payment solutions and build confidence with potential business clients. The design pairs a dark interface with vibrant lime accents, bold typography, and technology-inspired imagery to create a modern visual identity. Clear navigation, prominent trust indicators, and a focused “Talk to Sales” call to action help visitors explore the company’s offerings and connect with its team.

items.title: Generative brand toolkit
